name: Apple Cooler
ingredients: 150 ml apple juice, 100 ml sparkling water, ice
instructions: Fill a glass with ice, add apple juice and top with sparkling water. Stir gently.

name: Carrot & Apple Blend
ingredients: 150 ml carrot juice, 100 ml apple juice, 1 teaspoon lemon juice
instructions: Combine the carrot and apple juices, stir in the lemon juice and serve chilled.
